# Blockbench MCP

- Repository: https://github.com/XiaoNetwork-Astral/blockbench-mcp
- Upstream: https://github.com/jasonjgardner/blockbench-mcp-plugin
- License: GPL-3.0-only
- Version: 2.0.0-blockbench.1
- Artifact: `dist/blockbench_mcp.js`
- Default MCP URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/bb-mcp`

## Interface

- 118 core direct tools and 17 YSM tools, plus 12 Hytale tools when its plugin is installed.
- Validation tools provide transformed-contact, UV-integrity, snapshot/diff (the latest eight in-memory snapshots per project), repeatable view/debug-pass, visibility, and native-animation sweep operations.
- YSM tools provide workspace synchronization, source-backed Molang discovery, parsing, semantic/runtime validation, deterministic simulation, clone-only preview, and targeted JSONC editing.
- Every tool accepts its operation-specific input object directly.
- Project-scoped calls use the Blockbench tab visible when execution begins; `select_project` visibly changes the tab.
- API docs are generated with `bun run docs` at `docs/index.html` and `docs/api.json`.

## Modeling

- Read `AGENTS.md` before modeling. Apply project-specific instructions only when the current workspace supplies them.
- Creation defaults to the Outliner root and duplication stays beside the original; supply a parent when building hierarchy, and always name the destination when reparenting.
- Check important attachments with coordinates and front, side, top, and three-quarter views.
- Work in small stages and ask the user to inspect when structure or depth is uncertain.
- Do not overwrite baselines or discard unsaved work without explicit authorization.

## Development

- Install: `bun install`
- Test: `bun run check`
- Generate docs: `bun run docs`
- Build: `bun run build`
- Contribution rules: `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- Connection examples: `llms-install.md`
